But I know this much for sure.
You two are Umamusume who want to win your races too!

What is this memo...
"Prestigious Tracen Academy Students Partying at Night During Training Camp"?!

If you just wanted to play, you could goof off all you want. But you girls
pushed through harsh training and kept facing running head-on!

...Hm?
Those two, they're from the arcade incident—

Having fun is important alongside running, right?
I'm sure it's just like kendo is to me...
I-I'm sorry...

This smartphone has its recording function on... I see.
You were a gossip reporter aiming for a scandal!

These girls say they wanna go, y'know?
Come on, let's head out.
Ah, hey! Hold on right there!!

Trainer!
I look forward to your continued guidance!!

I learned a bit too.
The joy of taking a break, and how important it is—

Then that's what matters most!
Let's both sprint at full throttle toward our dreams togetherrr!!

Look, that whole hot-blooded straightforward routine?
It's not in style anymore. Total relic of the past.

Ah, we need to contact the Trainer
or an adult, too...!
There you go again... We're just...!

Yeah, yeah!
We worked hard, so what's wrong with having a little fun?

...We have to, right?
Um, Bamboo's Trainer is—
Heh... Blowing off steam is important, after all.

You have dreams, don't you! You have the drive to win!
But if you cause trouble, you won't be able to fulfill them...

It's totally fine!
No one's gonna notice if we're just a little late♪
Huh?
I can't stand the thought of that happening!!
Eh?

Yeah, we were in the wrong.
Even though the Disciplinary Committee Head was genuinely worried about us.
Haaaaaaah!!!
You suspicious person over there, don't move! Police!!
Pfft, look at you getting scolded~
You little...! Give that back right now!!

...It's true that I don't know
every little thing about you two.
Disciplinary Committee Head...

The annual summer training camp—in an environment different from usual,
Bamboo Memory puts even more energy into her training.

Not really... but during the day, some unfamiliar guy was talking to them.
Saying he'd show them around nearby, or hang out together—

Heheh♪
At this rate, doesn't it look like we'll finish early?

But if you break the rules like this, you won't be able to have fun
or run anymore! That'd be such a waste!

M-Mind your own business!
You don't know the first thing about us anyway!

That wraps it up.
...Hey, you. Let's hear your side of the story down at the station!

S-Shut up!
In the first place, you two are the ones who—

Well, we definitely learned our lesson.
Besides... we do have them too, after all. You know... dreams.

But... if we make another mistake like this time,
please scold us properly.
Right on!!

Let go!
...Damn it! My stuff...!

Trainer?!
And the police officer... why...

It's all right now!
Public order has been maintained!

At this rate, a stern warning won't be the end of it!
You two, come back with me!

Yes, sir! We'll maintain order, take breaks when needed,
and definitely win our races!!

All right! Running on sand puts a lot of load on the legs,
but it's great not having to worry about hoof wear.

Mmm, this is a grave situation!
Did you hear where they were headed?

The Disciplinary Committee protects students in danger!
I'm going to rescue those two!!
All right, I'm going for one more rep too!!
Hmm... Was that really okay, I wonder?

In the nick of time—just before the suspicious man could grab Bamboo Memory,
it seemed we managed to arrive alongside the police.

Yeah...
I sent a message, but got no reply.

Yep, yep!
Running clean and having fun is definitely the best, sir!

Burn with passion, hot-blooded training!!
Summer Training Camp Edition: Part Teeeeen!!

Huh?
Those two haven't returned?

Afterward—the two Umamusume diligently upheld discipline,
and let loose completely at the summer festival held on the final day of the camp.
Th-That was so scary...!

Hold it, sir!
Your cover's totally blown, sir!!

Phew!
How was that, sir? My beach dash!
